author: reek
body: SD parameter explorer server. Runs bare-metal in the VM, handles request lines on serial, responds with JSON. The PowerShell bridge handles HTTP, file I/O, and SD API proxying.

author: val
body: Wire protocol. Request: METHOD /path?key=val&key=val. Response: STATUS content-type BODY. Special: CONFIG model|sampler|lora|upscaler NAME, fed by the bridge at boot.
